All 55 SimplexSolver tests pass.

## Summary of changes

Iteration 1 already pulled out the larger helpers (`findMinRatioRows`, `findArtificialVariableRow`, `selectRowByBlandsRule`, `iterateUntilOptimal`, `checkSolutionIsNonNegative`). Two minor smells remained:

1. **`parseOptimizationData`** (`SimplexSolver.java:177`) — the loop body had two `if` blocks each ending in a redundant `continue`. Switched to `if / else if`, which is idiomatic and removes the dead `continue` statements.

2. **Cut-off comparison duplicated in two places** — both `isValidPivotColumn` (line 232) and `findMinRatioRows` (line 290) used `Precision.compareTo(entry, 0d, cutOff) > 0`, and a comment in `isValidPivotColumn` explicitly noted "do the same check as in getPivotRow", manually flagging that the two must stay in sync. Extracted a private `isAboveCutOff(double)` helper used at both call sites; the stale sync-warning comment is no longer needed.

No public APIs, signatures, numerical behavior, or tolerances were changed. The code remains Java 6/7 compatible (no new imports, no Java 8+ APIs).
